case_name: Joginder Singh v State of Punjab and Others
holding: The judgments cited by the appellant are distinguishable.
Therefore, we cannot be persuaded to interpret the remission notification of the Punjab Government to run counter to the judgment of this Court referred to hereinabove.
In our opinion, while applying the period of remission granted by the Government under any remission notification the period during which an accused person was on bail cannot be taken into account.
